sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build, kickoff Sun 7:20pm CT. Sold 355, 5,020 resting. Worst line -$261 (goal -$150).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (150+ behind the leader): DAL by 1-6, DAL by 7-14, DAL by 15+, GB by 1-6, GB by 7-14.
DAL by 1-6: 317 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
DAL by 7-14: 317 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate closed: batches wait for the worst line to reach -$200 (now -$261).
Closest: GB by 15+, 583 resting vs trigger 188.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$300.
Paid balancing starts Sun 6:35pm CT: worst line to -$150 by Sun 7:10pm CT, up to $100.
At Sun 6:50pm CT, if worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Sun 7:20pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
